svg.aria-label: What a layer 4 load balancer can see compared with a layer 7 one
svg.text: a connection to 104.20.26.136:443 → pick a server, forward every packet of it
fast, simple, and can't see inside TLS
GET /photos/beans.jpg, Host: garden.example, Cookie: … → the photo servers
ends TLS, so it can read, route and rewrite requests

figure.figcaption: Two kinds of load balancer. Big sites use both: layer 4 balancers spread connections over a fleet of layer 7 proxies, which hold the certificates, read the requests, and pass them on. QUIC’s visible connection ID (Chapter 33) exists so that layer 4 balancers can keep each connection on the same server.
